title: Pro Leadership: Establishing Your Credibility, Building Your Following and Leading With Impact
author: Jo Owen
target_audience: Managers and team leaders in business settings
Professionals seeking to enhance leadership effectiveness
Individuals interested in influence and organizational impact
core_themes: Building and engaging a loyal following
Creating lasting impact through intentional leadership
Personal development and growth as a leader
primary_purpose: To equip readers with the tools, mindset, and behaviors necessary to become a credible and impactful leader by fostering trust, building strong followings, and navigating the challenges of leading in a modern professional context.

structure_format.organization: Structured into themed chapters that guide readers through the journey from establishing credibility to amplifying impact, each introducing key principles, action steps, and reflection questions
features: Case studies and anecdotes from real leaders

key_concepts_lessons: Credibility is foundational for leadership and is built through integrity, competence, and consistency.
Influence and followership are earned rather than granted by position.
Authenticity, clear values, and communication are essential to winning trust.
Effective leaders align personal goals with organizational vision and values.
Impactful leadership depends on ongoing learning and adaptability.
Building communities and networks is crucial for sustainable influence.
style_tone: Grounded in research and practical experience
notable_features: Focus on self-leadership as the basis for leading others
Combines research insights with pragmatic advice
Contains actionable frameworks and practical tools for immediate implementation
Highlights common leadership pitfalls and ways to avoid them
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2019 as part of a modern wave of leadership literature focused on authenticity, influence, and adaptability—reflecting shifts in workplace culture toward transparency, trust, and collaboration amid rapid organizational change.
reception_impact: Well received by business professionals and leadership coaches
Praised for distilling complex leadership ideas into actionable steps
Regarded as accessible for both new and seasoned leaders
Appreciated for practical examples and clarity
comparable_titles: Leaders Eat Last by Simon Sinek
Dare to Lead by Brené Brown
The Leadership Challenge by James Kouzes and Barry Posner
The 21 Irrefutable Laws of Leadership by John C. Maxwell
